text: President Trump calls for the elimination of the filibuster and the passage of the "SAVE America Act," his elections overhaul bill.
translated_text: 特朗普总统呼吁消除阻挠议事并通过“拯救美国法案”，即他的选举改革法案。

text:
The President's Independence Eve speech is still largely on script, but the message has shifted to what Trump calls the "greatest threat." 

"Communism is the enemy of free people everywhere."

This is his message ahead of the midterms.
translated_text:
总统的独立前夕演讲很大程度上仍是照本宣科，但信息已转向特朗普所说的“最大威胁”。 

“共产主义是世界各地自由人民的敌人。”

这是他在中期选举前传达的信息。

text: Trump: "In America we speak English because that is the language of our founding." (People in the crowd cheered).
translated_text: 特朗普：“在美国，我们说英语，因为这是我们立国之本。” （人群中的人们欢呼起来）。

text:
President Trump asks "What does it mean to be an American?"

"There is no American freedom without American culture."

"There is no American founding without American people."
translated_text:
特朗普总统问道：“作为一个美国人意味着什么？”

“没有美国文化就没有美国自由。”

“没有美国人民就没有美国的建国。”

text:
President Trump has largely stuck to his speech script that is focused so far on America's founding, freedom, and future.

"You live in a very special place, congratulations everybody."
translated_text:
特朗普总统基本上坚持了他的演讲稿，到目前为止，其重点是美国的建国、自由和未来。

“你们生活在一个非常特别的地方，祝贺大家。”
